content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement, and the document expressly disclaims exclusivity.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best rates", "favor" and "pricing" return nothing, and a full read of the single section confirms the Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation, price-matching or "terms no less favourable" undertaking anywhere. The Fees and Payment clause (§5, p0023) is a pure revenue-share mechanic with no benchmarking against third-party terms, and §1 (p0001) affirmatively confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from offering Inventory through other agents or selling to third parties. This matches the preferred position — no MFN obligation burdens the Customer — so there is nothing to redline; the rule is directional and does not require an affirmative Vendor-granted MFN.
